captain.summary.outro: The armband does not appear in the standings, but the choice still says something about a club. When a season turns, the player whose voice lands first in the dugout can matter as much as any formal title.
captain.summary.outro.v1: The armband does not appear in the standings, but the choice still says something about a club. When a season turns, the player whose voice lands first in the dugout can matter as much as any formal title.
captain.summary.outro.v2: The assignments are expected to hold unless the roster forces a change. If a captain leaves during the year, clubs will move quickly rather than wait for another spring.
captain.summary.outro.v3: Captaincy is not a stat line, but it shows up when the schedule gets heavy. Clubs made these choices for the days when the dugout needs a steady voice before it needs a speech.
captain.replacement.title: {team_name} changes captain mid-season
captain.replacement.body_departed:
{team_link} moved quickly to fill its captaincy opening after {old_player_link} left the roster. The new captain is {new_player_link}.

Midseason captaincy changes are less ceremony than housekeeping. Players need to know whose voice carries routine issues, dugout temperature and the messages between staff and roster. The club chose not to let that role sit vacant.
